rules: Installed is ASSUMED 0 only for conditional new-start PCS proven not yet cut at the capture clock: the reviewed recipe's gap is known and every WIP match of that exact product/size is resolved (no UNKNOWN/NEEDS_CHECK). Already cut WIP needs its own physical installation source and exact product/size link; unresolved identity keeps installation UNKNOWN. Issue is never consumption.

Allocated unused = current unposted Native cutting composition linked by a CP7 intent to that exact target, only when every line is the recipe fabric, AVAILABLE/HALF_USED, consistent, at an active RAW_MATERIAL_WAREHOUSE and the roll/location stock covers every unposted draft on it (linked or not). It is a plan, not a reservation.

Free eligible stock (same roll/location rules, minus every unposted draft) is added only when the claimant set is complete (no other ACTIVE/unreviewed row with an unknown fabric or unknown gap) and the split is unique: either it covers every claimant's outstanding need, or there is exactly one claimant.

Open opening-balance purchase commitments (remaining via the unchanged BB function) count once, only for a single complete claimant, only from an active raw warehouse and only when the WIB expected date's end is on or before the target deadline. Null or overdue expected dates are UNKNOWN; commitments after the deadline are excluded.

Any unlinked unposted Native draft on the fabric, inconsistent or negative roll stock, unresolved shared split, unknown deadline or paused/stopped production makes the external addition UNKNOWN with a reason code. Nothing unproved becomes zero.

Unbound same-model/size WIP whose brand/color is unproved (NEEDS_CHECK/UNKNOWN for the target) may already hold this target's fabric: installation is UNKNOWN (FABRIC_WIP_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED) and the kernel value computed with installed0 is only an upper bound, reported in the reason; the external addition stays UNKNOWN, even when that bound is 0.

External = the trusted material-need kernel: max(0, gross - installed - allocated - on-time incoming). Global production feasibility stays UNKNOWN (rounding multiple and capacity policies remain unconfirmed).

labels: Only a linked Native draft composition (or no allocation at all) is KNOWN. Installed, free-stock allocation and external are ASSUMED because they rest on the recipe and the scenario; a product-bound fixture does not make them KNOWN.
recipe_identity_fix: Recipe review identity now hashes Native fabric master fields only (cp7_fabric_native.material_hash: id, sku, name, type, unit, active, accessory category, created_at). Every receipt/issue rewrites cached_stock_qty, moving_average_cost, row_version and updated_at, which previously voided every reviewed recipe. A real master field revision still voids it; fabric13 MASTER_CHANGED now renames the master, and the Shell SQL control adds cache-rewrite-keeps-review (26 controls).

plan_apply_own_draft_fix.defect: apply re-checked its Original after its own Native SAVE_DRAFT; the P08 physical fingerprint counted that draft as a foreign change (CP7_PLAN_SOURCE_CHANGED on every reviewed-fabric draft, CI run 37360628807)
plan_apply_own_draft_fix.fix: apply marks its own new cutting group in cp7_plan_native.apply_own_drafts only around the post-write preflight; physical_source skips it only when txid equals the running transaction; the row is deleted before commit
plan_apply_own_draft_fix.unchanged: every other physical, stock, draft, intent and commitment change still stales the Original; the marker table is private and verified empty
plan_apply_own_draft_fix.consequence: after one committed apply, the old Original is ARCHIVED_STALE; the next apply needs a fresh capture (fail-closed)

scale_bounds.rolls: only rolls with a nonzero per-location quantity at the capture time, or used by an unposted draft; emptied history never enters
scale_bounds.commitments: 10000 bound applied after selecting open lines; closed lines never push an open line out
scale_bounds.refusal: CP7_FABRIC_PHYSICAL_LIMIT above a bound, never silent truncation
